# November soil under the leaves

Left leaves on one bed and cleared the other. The covered soil is softer, but the cleared bed is nearer the path and gets more feet. Avoid writing a triumphant note about mulch on this evidence alone. [[Garden notebook]]: a photograph can preserve a contrast without explaining it. Compare again after moving the stepping stones.
